literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) describes C-terminal GFP fusions of full-length GYPB cloned into pEGFP-N2. pEGFP-N2 appends GFP after the last residue of the insert (residue 91, A). Per the authoritative topology landmarks, residues 82–91 are intracellular; the GFP is therefore on the cytoplasmic face, not the extracellular surface. This qualifies as a tolerated intracellular C-terminal fusion and is recorded in other_positions, but it does not support an extracellular tag site. No ledger line describes an N-terminal, internal-loop, or any extracellular-face insertion for GYPB. Zero sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal GFP fusion (pEGFP-N2) appended after the last residue of full-length GYPB; residue 91 (A) is intracellular (topology landmarks: intracellular span 82–91), so this is a cytoplasmic label, not an extracellular surface tag.
